3269.title: Markdown table breakout collapses content-sized messages
3269.rootCauseOneLine: A page-sized table breakout participates in shrink-to-fit user-message sizing, allowing the Markdown content width to collapse while observer-written geometry feeds the same layout.
3269.proposedFix: Give the breakout a stable containing width outside the shrink-to-fit bubble and add a real-browser user-message regression that checks non-zero settled widths.
3269.caveats: The trusted build reproduced a deterministic zero-width collapse, not the reported intermittent flicker.
